Gradual hair loss of the eyelashes, eyebrows, beard, and scalp for 4 years
response.rationale: Acid-fast bacilli in a foamy histiocyte infiltrate with madarosis and skin nodules are pathognomonic for lepromatous leprosy; sarcoidosis lacks AFB and typically shows non-caseating granulomas, while RA is contradicted by normal anti-CCP and the AFB finding.

rejected.why: No acid-fast bacilli; foamy histiocytes and uveitis/lymphadenopathy are less specific and sarcoidosis does not cause madarosis.
Normal anti-CCP and CRP, plus AFB-positive skin biopsy, exclude rheumatoid arthritis as the primary diagnosis.
